player_prompt.intro:
Wai Mwari {player_id} muSimpleTak.
Pabhoja, miwiri yako inowanikwa se '{player_stone}' na miwiri yemupingi inowanikwa se '{opponent_stone}'.

Pamuda yako, chagua cello rima (ne indeksi yake yakatumidzwa) na uweke mwiri wako kuno.
Saka mfano, '[12]' unaweka mwiri wako mucelle 12.

Chikwata chako kuchema njere yekuwirirana kwa miwiri yako inokunda mativi akawanda ebhoja (kubva juu-kudzoka kana kushure-kukwira).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nhamba yechero isiriyo {cell_num}. Inofanira kuva pakati pe 0 ne {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Sero {cell_num} ratotorwa. Sarudza sero risina chinhu.
